champion.tips: LEE SIN TIPS AND TRICKS Just because you hit your Q , it doesn’t mean you have to go in. Refrain from following every Q . Try and initiate ganks with your W rather than Q . If you use your Q and miss, it is going to result in a failed gank. It will also be harder for you to land your Q the further you’re away from the enemy. Flash kick R the enemy carry or squishy champion into your team. Do not kick R the enemy tank or engage champion as you’ll do more harm than good.
champion.builds: THE BEST LEE SIN BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR JUNGLE IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Lee Sin Jungle build, you should take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Conqueror as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, as well as Cosmic Insight and Magical Footwear in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Eclipse as your first item, followed by Plated Steelcaps and Sundered Sky. For your last 3 items, you should build Black Cleaver, Death's Dance and finish with Guardian Angel. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - W - E. Right now, this build has 52.3% winrate over 53 826 matches played. Optional Your second option for Lee Sin Jungle build would be to take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, and Cosmic Insight with Magical Footwear in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Sundered Sky, which you should build first, followed by Mercury's Treads as your second item and Black Cleaver as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Sterak's Gage, Guardian Angel and Death's Dance. The skill order for this build is Q - W - E. In the current patch, this build has a 50.5% win rate over 16 304 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, and Cosmic Insight with Magical Footwear in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Profane Hydra as your first item, then Plated Steelcaps as a second item and Eclipse as a third item. You want to finish the build with Sundered Sky, Black Cleaver and Sterak's Gage. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - W - E. This build is currently sitting at a 53.7% win rate across 1 306 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Lee Sin Jungle build in the current patch, try Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, Electrocute, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Ultimate Hunter as your primary rune tree, and Coup de Grace with Triumph as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Eclipse as your first item, then finish Plated Steelcaps as your second item, and Sundered Sky as third item. The last 3 options are Black Cleaver, Death's Dance and Guardian Angel. The ability order for this build is Q - W - E. As of the current patch, this build has a 44.2% win rate over 561 matches played. Situational Lee Sin Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Lee Sin build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Lee Sin runes page.
